items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复和iPSC药物发现的研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究生涯的回顾性文章，总结了从神经发育基础研究到再生医学转化的历程。关键内容包括：发现RNA结合蛋白Musashi在神经干细胞中的功能；建立神经干细胞分离方法；开展脊髓损伤的临床前和临床研究，包括iPSC衍生神经干细胞移植的首次人体试验；开发ALS患者iPSC平台，筛选出罗匹尼罗作为治疗候选药物。文章强调未来再生医学需要多学科整合。
items.insight: 这篇文章对ALS研究者具有重要价值，因为它详细描述了iPSC药物发现平台从基础研究到临床转化的完整路径，特别是罗匹尼罗的发现过程，为ALS药物开发提供了可复制的范式。同时，作者提出的多学科整合观点，为ALS治疗策略的制定提供了宏观视角。

aiRead.keyFinding: iPSC筛选确定罗匹尼罗为ALS治疗候选药物，并实现了反向转化研究；iPSC衍生神经干细胞移植进入首次人体临床试验。
aiRead.limitation: 作为回顾性文章，未提供新的实验数据，且部分内容为作者个人观点。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注罗匹尼罗在ALS中的后续临床试验结果，以及iPSC衍生细胞移植治疗脊髓损伤的临床数据更新。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和iPSC药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的神经干/祖细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，从损伤病理生理学分析和分子干预，到使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终导致了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台，用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了罗匹尼罗（Ropinirole）作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于2026年，总结了iPSC技术在ALS药物发现中的最新进展，并强调了从基础研究到临床转化的整合，具有高度的转化价值。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.
items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 这项法国多中心回顾性研究（FORSLA）分析了46名接受Tofersen治疗的SOD1-ALS患者，发现治疗12个月后，功能衰退速度（ALSFRS-R进展率）显著减缓，血液NfL水平显著下降。与历史对照相比，Tofersen组生存期更长，死亡风险降低约66%。但研究为观察性设计，存在局限性，结果提示Tofersen在真实世界中可能带来临床获益。
items.insight: 该研究提供了Tofersen在真实世界中的疗效证据，支持其作为SOD1-ALS靶向治疗的价值，并提示NfL作为生物标志物的监测作用，对ALS精准治疗策略的优化具有重要参考意义。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估Tofersen在法国真实世界环境中对超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的比较。研究纳入来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALSFRS-R进展率从基线的0.53±0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22±0.3点/月（P=0.006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0±9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2±19.5 pg/ml（P=0.004）。与倾向评分匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率组间无统计学显著差异（P=0.30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分组间差异显著（时间-治疗交互作用P=0.006）。倾向评分匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P=0.004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P=0.03）。Tofersen似乎与功能衰退减缓及NfL水平降低相关。尽管必须承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，这些发现提供了提示Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年最新真实世界数据，直接评估SOD1-ALS靶向药物Tofersen的临床获益，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Neutralization of pathogenic PC-OxPL by AAV-delivered scFv as a therapeutic strategy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder defined by progressive motor neuron loss and TDP-43 proteinopathy, yet the upstream drivers of this pathology remain unclear. Oxidized phosphatidylcholines (PC-OxPL) have emerged as potent inducers of proteinopathy in the central nervous system (CNS), but their role in ALS has not been systematically explored. We identify a distinct PC-OxPL signature in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of patients with sporadic ALS (sALS) and show that apolipoprotein E (apoE)-containing particles are the primary PC-OxPL carriers in this compartment. In human iPSC-derived motor neurons, PC-OxPL exposure triggered disease-relevant transcriptional alterations and TDP-43 pathology, establishing PC-OxPL as a mediator of ALS-like neurodegeneration in vitro . To counteract this toxicity, we engineered an Adeno-Associated Virus (AAV)-delivered single-chain antibody fragment (scFv), PC-OxPL-VecTab, targeting PC-OxPL neoepitopes. PC-OxPL-VecTab neutralized PC-OxPL-induced neurotoxicity, reduced TDP-43 aggregation, and prevented motor neuron death and behavioral deficits in a sALS CSF transfer mouse model. Intrathecal delivery of PC-OxPL-VecTab in minipigs achieved broad CNS biodistribution and transgene expression, supporting the feasibility of CNS delivery. These findings position PC-OxPL as a mechanistic contributor to ALS pathogenesis and establish PC-OxPL-VecTab as a therapeutic strategy for ALS with potential broader applicability to disorders associated with PC-OxPL accumulation.
items.titleZh: 通过AAV递送的scFv中和致病性PC-OxPL作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，散发性ALS患者脑脊液中的氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）水平升高，并可通过含apoE的颗粒携带。在人类运动神经元中，PC-OxPL暴露导致TDP-43病理和疾病相关转录变化。研究者开发了一种AAV递送的单链抗体（PC-OxPL-VecTab），能够中和PC-OxPL毒性，减少TDP-43聚集，并在小鼠模型中改善运动功能和生存。小型猪实验显示鞘内递送可行。该研究提示PC-OxPL可能是ALS的潜在治疗靶点。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统性地将PC-OxPL与ALS发病机制联系起来，并提供了从患者样本到动物模型再到大型动物递送的完整证据链，为ALS治疗开辟了新方向，值得关注其后续临床转化进展。

aiRead.watchNext: 关注PC-OxPL-VecTab的临床前毒理学和IND申报进展，以及PC-OxPL作为生物标志物的验证研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以进行性运动神经元丢失和TDP-43蛋白病为特征，但其上游驱动因素尚不清楚。氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）已被证明是中枢神经系统中蛋白病的强效诱导剂，但其在ALS中的作用尚未被系统探索。我们在散发性ALS（sALS）患者的脑脊液（CSF）中鉴定出独特的PC-OxPL特征，并显示含载脂蛋白E（apoE）的颗粒是该区室中PC-OxPL的主要载体。在人类iPSC来源的运动神经元中，PC-OxPL暴露触发了疾病相关的转录改变和TDP-43病理，确立了PC-OxPL作为ALS样神经退行性变的体外介质。为了对抗这种毒性，我们设计了一种AAV递送的单链抗体片段（scFv）PC-OxPL-VecTab，靶向PC-OxPL新表位。PC-OxPL-VecTab中和了PC-OxPL诱导的神经毒性，减少了TDP-43聚集，并在sALS CSF转移小鼠模型中防止了运动神经元死亡和行为缺陷。在小型猪中鞘内递送PC-OxPL-VecTab实现了广泛的中枢神经系统生物分布和转基因表达，支持CNS递送的可行性。这些发现将PC-OxPL定位为ALS发病机制的机制性贡献者，并确立PC-OxPL-VecTab作为ALS的治疗策略，可能对与PC-OxPL积累相关的疾病具有更广泛的适用性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合了患者CSF脂质组学、iPSC神经元模型和AAV基因治疗，提出了针对氧化脂质新表位的创新治疗策略，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: i.c.v. delivery of AAV9-synapsin-promoted caveolin-1 attenuates neuromuscular deficits and neuromuscular degeneration in hSOD1 G93A mice.
items.summary: Practical and broad biodistributable gene delivery interventions are essential for advancing therapeutic strategies targeting neurodegenerative diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). We previously demonstrated that subpial delivery of AAV9-synapsin-promoted caveolin-1 ( SynCav1 ) afforded significant neuroprotective effects in mutant superoxide dismutase (SOD)-1-induced ALS pathology. However, subpial delivery is regionally restricted, technically challenging, and highly invasive. This study evaluated whether the intracerebroventricular (i.c.v.) route of administration (ROA), an alternative CNS delivery strategy less invasive than direct spinal cord injections, could achieve broader CNS biodistribution and produce functional or histological benefits in hSOD1 G93A mice. i.c.v. administration of AAV9- SynCav1 achieved widespread Cav-1 overexpression in the motor cortex and spinal cord. SynCav1 -treated male mice exhibited improved running wheel (RW) performance and better motor-evoked potentials. Immunofluorescence revealed attenuated degeneration of cholinergic motor neurons (MNs) in the cervical and lumbar ventral horn, as well as preserved diaphragm neuromuscular junction (NMJ) innervation in SynCav1- treated mice. These findings serve as preclinical proof of concept that i.c.v. delivery of AAV9- SynCav1 can achieve CNS target engagement and produce selective functional and anatomical benefits in hSOD1 G93A mice.
items.titleZh: 脑室内递送AAV9-synapsin启动子驱动的caveolin-1可减轻hSOD1 G93A小鼠的神经肌肉缺陷和神经肌肉变性
items.summaryZh: 这项研究测试了一种新的基因递送方法：通过脑室内注射AAV9病毒载体，将caveolin-1基因导入ALS小鼠模型（hSOD1 G93A）的中枢神经系统。结果显示，该方法比传统的脊髓注射侵入性更小，且能有效在运动皮层和脊髓中表达目标蛋白，改善小鼠的运动功能（如跑轮表现和运动诱发电位），并减少运动神经元变性和神经肌肉接头丢失。这为ALS基因治疗提供了一种更安全、更广泛的递送途径。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS基因治疗提供了新的递送策略，脑室内注射相比软脊膜下注射更易操作且侵入性更低，同时能实现广泛的CNS分布，可能加速基因疗法向临床转化。

aiRead.keyFinding: 脑室内递送AAV9-SynCav1可实现广泛的CNS表达，改善运动功能并减轻神经肌肉变性。

aiRead.watchNext: 关注该递送策略在更大动物模型中的验证，以及SynCav1在ALS其他模型（如C9orf72）中的效果。

items.abstractZh: 实用的、广泛生物分布的基因递送干预对于推进针对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）等神经退行性疾病的治疗策略至关重要。我们先前证明，软脊膜下递送AAV9-synapsin启动子驱动的caveolin-1（SynCav1）在突变超氧化物歧化酶（SOD1）诱导的ALS病理中具有显著的神经保护作用。然而，软脊膜下递送具有区域限制、技术难度高且高度侵入性。本研究评估了脑室内（i.c.v.）给药途径（ROA）——一种比直接脊髓注射侵入性更小的替代性中枢神经系统（CNS）递送策略——是否能在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中实现更广泛的CNS生物分布并产生功能或组织学益处。i.c.v.给予AAV9-SynCav1在运动皮层和脊髓中实现了广泛的Cav-1过表达。SynCav1处理的雄性小鼠表现出改善的跑轮（RW）表现和更好的运动诱发电位。免疫荧光显示，SynCav1处理的小鼠颈段和腰段腹角胆碱能运动神经元（MNs）的变性减轻，以及膈肌神经肌肉接头（NMJ）支配的保留。这些发现作为临床前概念验证，表明i.c.v.递送AAV9-SynCav1可以实现CNS靶点参与，并在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中产生选择性的功能和解剖学益处。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用脑室内递送AAV9-SynCav1，在ALS小鼠模型中验证了非侵入性基因递送策略的可行性，具有转化价值。

items.title: Cell Death in Neurodegenerative Diseases: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Targets.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDs) are marked by selective neuronal vulnerability and progressive failure of neural circuits. Increasing evidence indicates that neuronal loss is not driven by a single terminal event, but emerges from interacting regulated cell death (RCD) programs. These programs are closely coupled to mitochondrial injury, proteostatic collapse, lysosomal stress, metabolic imbalance, glial state transitions, and chronic neuroinflammation. Yet, how distinct death pathways are organized across cell types, disease stages, and disease-specific microenvironments remains unresolved. This review examines RCD as an integrated pathogenic network in major NDs. Caspase and B-cell lymphoma 2 (BCL2) family signaling, receptor-interacting protein kinase 1 (RIPK1), RIPK3, and mixed lineage kinase domain-like protein activation, NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain containing 3 and gasdermin signaling, GPX4-linked lipid peroxidation control, and autophagy lysosomal failure are discussed as convergent stress response modules rather than isolated pathways. Across Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and Huntington's disease, these modules shape neuronal fate through disease-specific interactions with mitochondrial dysfunction, iron dyshomeostasis, inflammasome activation, and microglial metabolic remodeling. We further evaluate emerging therapeutic strategies that target cell death crosstalk, restore autophagy lysosomal competence, or improve delivery to the central nervous system, highlighting the importance of molecular selectivity, cellular context, disease stage, and translational feasibility.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的细胞死亡：分子机制与治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出，神经退行性疾病中的神经元死亡不是单一事件，而是由多种调节性细胞死亡（RCD）程序相互作用形成的网络。这些程序包括凋亡、坏死性凋亡、焦亡、铁死亡和自噬性细胞死亡，它们与线粒体损伤、蛋白稳态失衡、神经炎症等密切相关。文章强调，不同疾病（如ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和亨廷顿病）中，这些死亡模块以疾病特异性的方式相互作用，因此治疗策略需要针对细胞死亡串扰和疾病阶段进行精准设计。
items.insight: 对于ALS研究者而言，这篇综述提供了将细胞死亡机制视为整合网络的框架，有助于理解ALS中运动神经元死亡的复杂性，并指导开发针对多个死亡途径的联合治疗策略，而非单一靶点。

aiRead.keyFinding: 神经退行性疾病中的细胞死亡由多种RCD程序相互作用形成网络，而非单一途径；这些程序与线粒体损伤、神经炎症等紧密耦合，并呈现疾病特异性。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供新的实验数据；对具体疾病中细胞死亡模块的定量和时序关系仍缺乏深入解析。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对RIPK1或GPX4等关键节点的抑制剂在ALS动物模型中的疗效，以及细胞死亡串扰生物标志物的临床验证。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDs）以选择性神经元易损性和神经回路进行性衰竭为特征。越来越多的证据表明，神经元丢失并非由单一终末事件驱动，而是源于相互作用的调节性细胞死亡（RCD）程序。这些程序与线粒体损伤、蛋白稳态崩溃、溶酶体应激、代谢失衡、胶质细胞状态转变和慢性神经炎症密切相关。然而，不同死亡途径如何在细胞类型、疾病阶段和疾病特异性微环境中被组织起来，仍不清楚。本综述将RCD视为主要神经退行性疾病中的整合致病网络。半胱天冬酶和B细胞淋巴瘤2（BCL2）家族信号、受体相互作用蛋白激酶1（RIPK1）、RIPK3和混合谱系激酶结构域样蛋白激活、NOD样受体家族pyrin结构域包含3和gasdermin信号、GPX4相关的脂质过氧化控制以及自噬溶酶体衰竭，被讨论为汇聚的应激反应模块，而非孤立途径。在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和亨廷顿病中，这些模块通过与线粒体功能障碍、铁稳态失调、炎症小体激活和小胶质细胞代谢重塑的疾病特异性相互作用，塑造神经元命运。我们进一步评估了针对细胞死亡串扰、恢复自噬溶酶体能力或改善中枢神经系统递送的新兴治疗策略，强调了分子选择性、细胞背景、疾病阶段和转化可行性的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的调节性细胞死亡机制研究，并强调了ALS等疾病中细胞死亡串扰的转化治疗价值，为精准靶向治疗提供了新视角。

items.title: Beyond the Ribosome: The Expanding Role of the Nucleolus in Neurodegenerative Pathways.
items.summary: The nucleolus, long defined by its canonical role in ribosome biogenesis, has emerged as a critical nexus for cellular homeostasis, stress sensing, and disease pathogenesis. This article synthesizes a broad range of evidence to construct a comprehensive model of the nucleolus in the context of aging and neurodegeneration. We begin by detailing its fundamental architecture and the intricate process of ribosome production, before exploring the paradigm-shifting discovery of its vast, non-canonical proteome, which implicates it in DNA repair, cell cycle control, and genome stability. A central theme is the nucleolus's function as a primary cellular stress sensor, which, upon disruption by genetic, metabolic, or proteotoxic insults, initiates the nucleolar stress response. We provide a detailed examination of the downstream signaling cascades, focusing on the canonical p53-MDM2 axis and the interconnected mTOR pathway, which together translate nucleolar status into decisions of cell fate, including apoptosis and cell cycle arrest. We then focus on the brain, presenting the neuropathological and morphological alterations of the nucleolus-such as atrophy, fragmentation, and changes in volume-that serve as hallmarks of normal aging and neurodegenerative disorders, including Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and C9orf72-linked ALS/FTD. We explore the deep regulatory layers of epigenetics, where DNA methylation and histone modifications of ribosomal DNA genes are dysregulated in disease, and discuss how multi-omics approaches are unraveling the complex molecular landscape of nucleolar function. Finally, we introduce the emerging concept of a gut-brain-nucleolus axis, proposing how systemic factors like the gut microbiome may influence neuronal health by triggering nucleolar stress through inflammatory and metabolic mediators. Overall, by highlighting the nucleolus as a convergence point for diverse pathogenic pathways, we frame it as a promising and druggable target for novel therapeutic strategies aimed at promoting neuronal resilience and combating neurodegenerative diseases.

items.titleZh: 超越核糖体：核仁在神经退行性通路中不断扩展的作用
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述文章总结了核仁在神经退行性疾病中的新角色，超越了其传统的核糖体合成功能。核仁不仅是细胞应激传感器，还通过 p53-MDM2 和 mTOR 通路调控细胞命运。在 ALS（特别是 C9orf72 相关）、阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病中，核仁出现萎缩、碎裂等形态改变。文章还提出了肠-脑-核仁轴的概念，暗示肠道微生物可能通过炎症影响核仁功能。核仁被视为一个有前景的药物靶点。
items.insight: 这篇综述将核仁从传统的核糖体工厂重新定位为神经退行性疾病（包括 ALS）中的关键应激枢纽，为理解 C9orf72 相关 ALS/FTD 的病理机制提供了新视角，并提出了核仁作为可干预靶点的可能性，值得 ALS 研究者关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: 核仁在神经退行性疾病中作为应激传感器，其形态改变和应激反应通路（p53-MDM2、mTOR）是疾病标志，且可能受肠道微生物影响。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供新的实验数据；核仁作为药物靶点的可行性仍需临床验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注核仁应激反应在 ALS 动物模型中的干预研究，以及针对核仁的候选药物进入临床试验的进展。

items.abstractZh: 核仁长期以来以其在核糖体生物发生中的经典作用被定义，如今已 emerged 作为细胞稳态、应激感知和疾病发病机制的关键节点。本文综合了大量证据，构建了核仁在衰老和神经退行性疾病背景下的全面模型。我们首先详细介绍了其基本结构和核糖体产生的复杂过程，然后探讨了其庞大的非经典蛋白质组的范式转变性发现，该蛋白质组涉及 DNA 修复、细胞周期控制和基因组稳定性。一个核心主题是核仁作为主要细胞应激传感器的功能，当受到遗传、代谢或蛋白毒性损伤时，会启动核仁应激反应。我们详细检查了下游信号级联，重点关注经典的 p53-MDM2 轴和相互关联的 mTOR 通路，它们共同将核仁状态转化为细胞命运决定，包括凋亡和细胞周期停滞。然后我们聚焦于大脑，呈现核仁的神经病理学和形态学改变——如萎缩、碎裂和体积变化——这些是正常衰老和神经退行性疾病（包括帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和 C9orf72 相关的 ALS/FTD）的标志。我们探索了表观遗传学的深层调控层，其中核糖体 DNA 基因的 DNA 甲基化和组蛋白修饰在疾病中失调，并讨论了多组学方法如何揭示核仁功能的复杂分子景观。最后，我们引入了肠-脑-核仁轴的新兴概念，提出肠道微生物组等系统性因素可能通过炎症和代谢介质触发核仁应激，从而影响神经元健康。总体而言，通过强调核仁作为多种致病通路的汇聚点，我们将其定位为促进神经元弹性和对抗神经退行性疾病的新型治疗策略的有前景且可药物干预的靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于 2026 年，整合了核仁非经典功能、应激反应和肠-脑轴等最新进展，直接关联 ALS 的 C9orf72 病理，具有转化价值。

items.title: JP1 peptide modulates oxidative stress and autophagy via Keap1-Nrf2-ARE in ALS model mice.
items.summary: The simultaneous modulation of oxidative stress and autophagy represents a potential therapeutic strategy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), yet agents capable of coordinately regulating both processes remain scarce. The Keap1‑Nrf2‑ARE pathway serves as a critical hub linking redox homeostasis and autophagic regulation, making it an attractive target for ALS intervention. JWA is a stress‑responsive protein involved in cellular protection against oxidative injury, and its neuroprotective effects have been shown to depend on activation of the MEK/ERK‑Nrf2 axis. JP1 is a functional oligopeptide derived from the JWA protein that has been engineered to cross the blood-brain barrier and specifically target integrin αVβ3. Based on the link between JWA and Nrf2 signaling, we hypothesized that JP1 activates the Keap1‑Nrf2‑ARE pathway to coordinate antioxidant defense and autophagic clearance. Here, we evaluated this hypothesis in the SOD1‑G93A mouse model, a well‑established transgenic model of familial ALS, and elucidated the underlying mechanisms. We evaluated the efficacy of JP1 in the SOD1-G93A mice model using behavioral phenotyping and survival analysis. The coordinated mechanism was investigated in spinal cord tissues by profiling the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway and oxidative stress, quantifying autophagic flux (by Western blotting and transmission electron microscopy) and neuronal apoptosis, and evaluating histology (by Nissl staining and immunofluorescence). Integrated transcriptomic and proteomic analyses further elucidated the global molecular landscape underlying the therapeutic effects of JP1. JP1 treatment ameliorated motor deficits and extended survival in SOD1-G93A mice without adversely affecting liver or kidney function. JP1 crossed the blood-brain barrier, targeted motor neurons expressing integrin αVβ3, and activated the ERK pathway. This promoted Keap1/Cul3 degradation and Nrf2 nuclear translocation, thereby activating the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway to alleviate oxidative stress. Concurrently, JP1 restored autophagic flux, increased autophagic activity, attenuated motor neuron injury, suppressed neuronal apoptosis, and preserved neuronal structural integrity. The Nrf2 inhibitor ML385 reversed the protective effects of JP1 on survival, motor function, autophagy, oxidative stress, and neuronal apoptosis, which confirms that JP1 acts via the Nrf2 pathway. JP1 acts as a promising coordinator of antioxidant and autophagic processes by targeting the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway, thus highlighting its therapeutic potential for ALS.
items.titleZh: JP1肽通过Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路调节ALS模型小鼠的氧化应激和自噬
items.summaryZh: 这项研究在ALS小鼠模型（SOD1-G93A）中测试了一种名为JP1的肽，该肽源自JWA蛋白，能穿越血脑屏障并靶向运动神经元。结果显示，JP1通过激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路，同时减轻氧化应激并恢复自噬功能，从而改善运动功能并延长生存期。该研究为ALS治疗提供了新的候选药物，但尚需进一步验证其安全性和有效性。
items.insight: 这项研究首次将JWA衍生肽JP1与Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路联系起来，展示了单一分子同时调节氧化应激和自噬的潜力，为ALS治疗提供了新的策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: JP1通过激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路，减轻氧化应激并恢复自噬通量，改善ALS小鼠的运动功能和生存期。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于转基因小鼠模型，结果可能不完全适用于散发性ALS；且未进行人体临床试验，长期安全性未知。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注JP1的临床前毒理学和药代动力学研究，以及其在其他ALS模型（如TDP-43或C9orf72）中的验证。

items.abstractZh: 同时调节氧化应激和自噬是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的潜在治疗策略，但能够协调调控这两个过程的药物仍然稀缺。Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路是连接氧化还原稳态和自噬调节的关键枢纽，使其成为ALS干预的有吸引力的靶点。JWA是一种应激反应蛋白，参与细胞对抗氧化损伤的保护，其神经保护作用已被证明依赖于MEK/ERK-Nrf2轴的激活。JP1是源自JWA蛋白的功能性寡肽，经过工程改造可穿越血脑屏障并特异性靶向整合素αVβ3。基于JWA与Nrf2信号传导的联系，我们假设JP1激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路以协调抗氧化防御和自噬清除。在此，我们在SOD1-G93A小鼠模型（一种成熟的家族性ALS转基因模型）中评估了这一假设，并阐明了潜在机制。我们通过行为表型和生存分析评估了JP1在SOD1-G93A小鼠模型中的疗效。通过分析Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路和氧化应激、量化自噬通量（通过Western blotting和透射电子显微镜）和神经元凋亡，以及评估组织学（通过Nissl染色和免疫荧光），研究了脊髓组织中的协调机制。整合转录组和蛋白质组分析进一步阐明了JP1治疗效果背后的全局分子景观。JP1治疗改善了SOD1-G93A小鼠的运动缺陷并延长了生存期，且未对肝脏或肾脏功能产生不利影响。JP1穿越血脑屏障，靶向表达整合素αVβ3的运动神经元，并激活ERK通路。这促进了Keap1/Cul3降解和Nrf2核转位，从而激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路以减轻氧化应激。同时，JP1恢复了自噬通量，增加了自噬活性，减轻了运动神经元损伤，抑制了神经元凋亡，并保持了神经元结构完整性。Nrf2抑制剂ML385逆转了JP1对生存、运动功能、自噬、氧化应激和神经元凋亡的保护作用，这证实了JP1通过Nrf2通路发挥作用。JP1通过靶向Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路，作为抗氧化和自噬过程的协调因子，凸显了其在ALS中的治疗潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于ALS中氧化应激与自噬的协同调节，具有明确的转化价值，且JP1作为可穿越血脑屏障的肽类候选药物，为ALS治疗提供了新方向。

items.title: ["Jiaji" (EX-B2) electroacupuncture modulates NLRP3 inflammasome activation to improve limb dysfunction in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis mice].
items.summary: To investigate the regulatory effect of "Jiaji" (EX-B2) electroacupuncture (EA) on the NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain-associated protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome in the lumbar spinal cord and to explore its mechanism in improving limb dysfunction in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) mice. Fifty-four mice carrying the human superoxide dismutase 1 G93A (hSOD1 G93A ) gene were randomly divided into model, Jiaji EA, and inhibitor groups, with 18 mice per group. Eighteen mice not carrying the hSOD1 G93A gene served as wild group. At 60 d of age, the Jiaji EA group was given EA at L1-L2 and L5-L6 EX-B2 points with continuous wave, 1 mA, 2 Hz. The needles retained for 20 min, twice every week. The inhibitor group received intraperitoneal injection of the NLRP3 inhibitor (10 mg/kg, twice every week). All treatments were administered for 4 consecutive weeks. The survival period of mice in each group was observed to assess disease progression；the rotarod test was conducted to evaluate motor coordination and limb motor function；HE staining was used to observe pathological changes in the gastrocnemius, and muscle atrophy was assessed by measuring the cross-sectional area of the gastrocnemius fiber；Nissl staining was performed to evaluate the number of motor neurons in the lumbar spinal cord anterior horns；the protein expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1, apoptosis-associated speck-like protein (ASC), interleukin-1β (IL-1β), interleukin-18 (IL-18), and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) in the lumbar spinal cord were detected by Western blot；the mRNA expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, IL-1β, IL-18, and TNF-α were detected by real-time quantitative PCR. Compared with the wild group, mice in the model group exhibited shortened survival time ( P <0.01)；reduced time spent on the rotating rod starting from the 13 th week of age ( P <0.05)；significantly shorter and rounded gastrocnemius fibers with enlarged inter-fiber spaces, nuclear translocation and leakage. The cross-sectional area of the gastrocnemius fibers was reduced ( P <0.01)；the number of motor neurons in the spinal anterior horns was decreased ( P <0.01)；protein and mRNA expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, IL-1β, IL-18, and TNF-α were increased in the lumbar spinal cord ( P <0.01). Compared with the model group, survival time was prolonged in the Jiaji EA and inhibitor groups ( P <0.01)；rotarod time was prolonged starting from the 13 th week of age ( P <0.05)；gastrocnemius fibers exhibited more regular margins and larger morphology, with reduced inter-fiber spaces, and reduced number of rounded fibers and improvement in nuclear translocation and leakage；cross-sectional areas of gastrocnemius fiber were increased ( P <0.01)；the numbers of motor neurons in the spinal anterior horns were increased ( P <0.01)；protein and mRNA expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, IL-1β, IL-18, and TNF-α decreased in the lumbar spinal cord ( P <0.05, P <0.01). Compared with the inhibitor group, mice in the Jiaji EA group exhibited prolonged rotarod time from the 17 th week of age ( P <0.05)；the cross-sectional area of the gastrocnemius fiber increased ( P <0.05)；protein and mRNA expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1 and IL-18 in the lumbar spinal cord were higher ( P <0.05, P <0.01), while protein and mRNA expressions of TNF-α were lower ( P <0.05, P <0.01). EX-B2 EA improves limb function and prolongs survival in ALS mice, with its underlying mechanism potentially involving the alleviation of neuroinflammation through inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome activation. 目的 : 观察“夹脊”电针对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）小鼠腰段脊髓NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NLRP3）炎性小体的调控作用，探究“夹脊”电针治疗ALS肢体功能障碍的作用机制。 方法 : 将54只携带人超氧化物歧化酶1 G93A（hSOD1 G93A ）基因的小鼠随机分为模型组、夹脊电针组和抑制剂组，18只/组，将18只不携带hSOD1 G93A 基因的小鼠作为野生组。在各组小鼠60日龄时，夹脊电针组给予电针腰（L）1~L2、L5~ L6“夹脊”（连续波，1 mA，2 Hz，20 min/次，2次/周），抑制剂组给予小鼠腹腔注射NLRP3抑制剂（10 mg/kg，2次/周），各组均连续干预4周。观察并比较各组小鼠生存期差异;转棒式疲劳实验评估小鼠运动协调能力及肢体运动功能;HE染色法观察小鼠腓肠肌形态变化、腓肠肌肌纤维横截面面积以评估肌肉萎缩程度;Nissl染色法观察腰髓前角运动神经元数量;Western blot法检测腰髓NLRP3、半胱天冬酶1（Caspase-1）、凋亡相关斑点样蛋白（ASC）、白细胞介素1β（IL-1β）、白细胞介素18（IL-18）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）蛋白表达;实时荧光定量PCR法检测腰髓NLRP3、Caspase-1、ASC、IL-1β、IL-18、TNF-α mRNA表达。 结果 : 与野生组比较，模型组小鼠生存期缩短（ P <0.01）;13周龄起转棒时间缩短（ P <0.05）;腓肠肌肌纤维明显缩短、呈幼圆形，肌纤维间隙增大，见细胞核内移或外漏，腓肠肌肌纤维横截面面积减小（ P <0.01）;脊髓前角运动神经元数量减少（ P <0.01）;腰髓NLRP3、Caspase-1、ASC、IL-1β、IL-18、TNF-α蛋白及mRNA表达增加（ P <0.01）。与模型组比较，抑制剂组和夹脊电针组小鼠生存期延长（ P <0.01）;13周龄起转棒时间延长（ P <0.05）;腓肠肌肌纤维边缘更规整、形态更大，肌纤维间隙缩小，幼圆形肌纤维数量降低，细胞核内移和外漏现象改善，腓肠肌肌纤维横截面面积增大（ P <0.01）;脊髓前角运动神经元数量增多（ P <0.01）;腰髓NLRP3、Caspase-1、ASC、IL-1β、IL-18、TNF-α蛋白及mRNA表达降低（ P <0.05， P <0.01）。与抑制剂组比较，夹脊电针组小鼠17周龄起转棒时间延长（ P <0.05）;腓肠肌肌纤维横截面面积增大（ P <0.05）;腰髓NLRP3、Caspase-1、IL-18蛋白及mRNA表达增加（ P <0.05， P <0.01），TNF-α蛋白及mRNA表达降低（ P <0.05， P <0.01）。 结论 : “夹脊”电针可以改善ALS小鼠肢体功能障碍，延长其生存期，内在机制可能与抑制腰髓NLRP3炎性小体激活从而减轻神经炎性反应有关。.

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项大型纵向队列研究分析了美国超过990万名退伍军人的数据，发现ALS发病率与军种和军衔显著相关。空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者风险高于陆军，而海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险高于士兵；服役年限越长风险反而越低。这些差异在年轻退伍军人中尤为明显。研究提示特定军事环境暴露可能增加ALS风险，但具体暴露因素尚待识别。
items.insight: 这项研究是迄今规模最大的关于军事服役细节与ALS风险关联的分析之一，首次系统揭示了军种和军衔对ALS发病率的影响，为在军事人群中寻找具体环境暴露因素（如化学品、电磁场、疫苗等）提供了重要线索，对理解ALS的环境风险因素具有直接指导价值。

items.abstractZh: 服兵役是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服务的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军人中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国（US）军种和军衔与偶发ALS的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，纳入2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。偶发ALS通过医疗记录识别。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。风险使用Cox比例风险模型估计，控制年龄，按种族/民族调整，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例偶发ALS病例，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例病例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与较高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低的发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在按年龄分层的模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性中最大（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51），在年长男性中最小（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境中。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2024年截止的超过990万退伍军人的最新纵向数据，首次系统量化了军种和军衔对ALS风险的影响，为ALS环境风险因素研究提供了新的转化线索。

items.title: Bridging the gap: neuroinflammation and the dawn of precision medicine in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Neuroinflammation is no longer a secondary feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but rather a disease-modifying process that actively shapes the motor neuron vulnerability from the earliest stages of pathology. Central and peripheral immune cells, including microglia, astrocytes, and infiltrating T lymphocytes, adopt context-dependent states that can be neuroprotective or neurotoxic depending on disease stage and genetic background. These states are driven by discrete molecular programs, such as cGAS-STING-mediated innate immune sensing, NLRP3 inflammasome activation, and RIPK1-dependent necroptotic signaling, which represent tractable therapeutic targets. The repeated failure of broad-spectrum immunosuppressive trials reflects a fundamental mismatch between the non-selective interventions and the mechanistically distinct immune states of diseases. Converging transcriptomic, genetic, and immunophenotypic evidence supports the existence of putative neuroimmune endotypes in ALS, though this framework remains a working hypothesis pending prospective validation in biomarker-stratified cohorts. Advances in the following three domains are needed for realizing precision immunotherapy: standardized biomarker panels (including cerebrospinal fluid chitinases and TSPO-PET) to stratify patients by inflammatory subtype; pharmacodynamic readouts to confirm target engagement before interpreting clinical outcomes; and adaptive platform trial designs capable of evaluating mechanism-matching interventions in defined subgroups. This review integrates ALS-associated neuroinflammation with emerging precision medicine strategies, arguing that the central translational question is no longer whether or not to target neuroinflammation, but how, when, and in whom neuroinflammation should be targeted.
items.titleZh: 弥合差距：肌萎缩侧索硬化中的神经炎症与精准医学的曙光
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述指出，神经炎症在ALS中不是被动旁观者，而是从早期就主动影响运动神经元损伤的关键过程。免疫细胞（如小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞、T细胞）在不同阶段和遗传背景下可表现出保护或毒性作用，其背后的分子通路（如cGAS-STING、NLRP3、RIPK1）是潜在治疗靶点。过去广谱免疫抑制治疗失败，提示需要根据患者的炎症亚型进行精准干预。文章提出未来需开发标准化生物标志物（如脑脊液几丁质酶、TSPO-PET）、药效学指标和自适应平台试验，以实现在正确的时间、对正确的患者、用正确的免疫调节策略。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了从'是否靶向神经炎症'转向'如何、何时、对谁靶向'的框架，强调神经免疫内型分层和生物标志物驱动的精准免疫治疗，是指导未来临床试验设计和转化研究的重要参考。

aiRead.keyFinding: 神经炎症是ALS疾病修饰过程，存在可区分的神经免疫内型，需通过生物标志物分层和机制匹配的干预来实现精准免疫治疗。
aiRead.limitation: 神经免疫内型框架仍是工作假设，缺乏前瞻性验证；综述未提供原始数据，证据等级为观察性。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续在生物标志物分层队列中验证神经免疫内型的临床研究，以及针对cGAS-STING、NLRP3、RIPK1等靶点的早期临床试验结果。

items.abstractZh: 神经炎症不再是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的次要特征，而是一种从病理最早阶段就主动塑造运动神经元易感性的疾病修饰过程。中枢和外周免疫细胞，包括小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞和浸润的T淋巴细胞，根据疾病阶段和遗传背景采用依赖上下文的状态，这些状态可以是神经保护性的或神经毒性的。这些状态由离散的分子程序驱动，如cGAS-STING介导的先天免疫感知、NLRP3炎症小体激活和RIPK1依赖性坏死性凋亡信号，这些代表了可操作的治疗靶点。广谱免疫抑制试验的反复失败反映了非选择性干预与疾病机制上不同的免疫状态之间的根本不匹配。转录组学、遗传学和免疫表型证据的汇聚支持ALS中推定神经免疫内型的存在，尽管这一框架仍是一个工作假设，有待在生物标志物分层队列中进行前瞻性验证。实现精准免疫治疗需要在以下三个领域取得进展：标准化生物标志物组合（包括脑脊液几丁质酶和TSPO-PET）以按炎症亚型对患者进行分层；药效学读数以在解释临床结果前确认靶点参与；以及能够评估特定亚组中机制匹配干预的自适应平台试验设计。这篇综述将ALS相关的神经炎症与新兴的精准医学策略相结合，认为核心的转化问题不再是是否靶向神经炎症，而是如何、何时以及在谁中靶向神经炎症。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的神经炎症分子机制与精准医学策略，直接指向ALS个体化免疫治疗的前沿方向，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Splicing modulation of ATXN2 as a therapeutic strategy to regulate Ataxin-2 protein levels in ALS.
items.summary: ATXN2 is associated with an increased risk of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), while down-regulation of ATXN2 has been shown to mitigate TDP-43 proteinopathy in ALS models. In this study, we demonstrated that Ataxin-2 protein levels were upregulated in rNLS8 mice following doxycycline withdrawal, which coincided with TDP-43 overexpression, phosphorylation, and aggregation. To reduce Ataxin-2 protein levels, we explored the approach of splicing modulation at the RNA level. Through bioinformatical analysis, we identified an alternative 5' splicing site of ATXN2 in intron 8. This alternative splicing results in an additional 47 base pairs at the 3' end after Exon 8. The insertion of the extra nucleotides causes a frameshift that leads to reduced mRNA production and, consequently, protein levels. Following the discovery of this alternative splicing site, we conducted an antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) micro-walk to screen ASOs targeting this region. We identified ASOs that specifically modulate this splicing, including those that either enhance or inhibit alternative splicing. We validated that the ASOs that promote alternative splicing and reduce constitutive splicing can lower Ataxin-2 protein levels, which in turn decreases TDP-43 aggregation and stress granule formation in a cell-based model of TDP-43 toxicity. Furthermore, we confirmed that reducing Ataxin-2 levels via previously validated ASO delivery ameliorated TDP-43 pathology in rNLS8 mice. The discovery of ATXN2 alternative splicing, along with the confirmation of splicing modulation using ASOs in human cell-based assays, provides evidence for a proof-of-principle strategy to modulate Ataxin-2 protein levels for the treatment of ALS.
items.titleZh: 剪接调控ATXN2作为调节ALS中Ataxin-2蛋白水平的治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 该研究发现ATXN2基因存在一个替代性5'剪接位点，可导致移码并降低Ataxin-2蛋白水平。通过设计反义寡核苷酸（ASO）靶向该位点，可增强替代剪接，从而在细胞模型中降低Ataxin-2蛋白、减少TDP-43聚集和应激颗粒形成。在rNLS8小鼠中，ASO递送也改善了TDP-43病理。这为通过剪接调控降低Ataxin-2水平治疗ALS提供了原理验证。
items.insight: 该研究首次在ATXN2中发现可调控的替代剪接位点，并利用ASO实现蛋白水平下调，为ALS治疗提供了新的RNA靶向策略，尤其针对TDP-43蛋白病这一核心病理机制。

aiRead.studyType: 机制研究（细胞和动物模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2内含子8存在替代5'剪接位点，ASO可增强该剪接从而降低Ataxin-2蛋白水平，并减少TDP-43病理。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于细胞和动物模型，尚未在人类患者中验证；ASO的长期安全性和有效性需进一步评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该ASO的临床前优化及在ALS患者来源细胞或动物模型中的进一步验证，以及是否进入临床试验阶段。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）风险增加相关，而下调ATXN2已被证明可减轻ALS模型中的TDP-43蛋白病。在本研究中，我们证明在rNLS8小鼠中，多西环素撤除后Ataxin-2蛋白水平上调，这与TDP-43过表达、磷酸化和聚集同时发生。为降低Ataxin-2蛋白水平，我们探索了在RNA水平进行剪接调控的方法。通过生物信息学分析，我们在ATXN2的内含子8中鉴定出一个替代性5'剪接位点。该替代剪接导致外显子8之后3'端额外增加47个碱基对。额外核苷酸的插入引起移码，导致mRNA产生减少，进而降低蛋白水平。在发现该替代剪接位点后，我们进行了反义寡核苷酸（ASO）微步移（micro-walk）以筛选靶向该区域的ASO。我们鉴定出能特异性调节该剪接的ASO，包括增强或抑制替代剪接的ASO。我们验证了促进替代剪接并减少组成性剪接的ASO可降低Ataxin-2蛋白水平，进而在TDP-43毒性的细胞模型中减少TDP-43聚集和应激颗粒形成。此外，我们确认通过先前验证的ASO递送降低Ataxin-2水平可改善rNLS8小鼠的TDP-43病理。ATXN2替代剪接的发现，以及在人细胞检测中使用ASO进行剪接调控的确认，为调节Ataxin-2蛋白水平以治疗ALS提供了原理验证策略的证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于最新发现的ATXN2替代剪接机制，利用ASO实现蛋白水平调控，具有直接的ALS治疗转化价值。

items.title: Living drug carriers: Microbial and bioengineered platforms redefining precision therapeutic and immunomodulatory delivery.
items.summary: Microbial living therapeutics are a new class of drug-delivery materials that combine synthetic biology, immunomodulation, and advanced formulations to achieve controllable therapeutic effects in space and time. In the broad field of living drug-delivery systems, therapeutic platforms include engineered microorganisms, mammalian immune cells, stem cells, viral vectors, extracellular-vesicle-producing cells, and hybrid bioengineered living materials. This review focuses on engineered microbial living drug carriers, including genetically modified bacteria and probiotic platforms, because these systems uniquely integrate programmable biosensing, in situ therapeutic synthesis, adaptive immunomodulation, and controllable drug delivery within a single living chassis. Designed microbes and consortia possess other unique functions, such as microenvironment sensing, programmed control of gene expression, and long-lasting in situ manufacturing of therapeutic payloads not available with small-molecule or biologic drugs. Recent progress in microbial chassis engineering, genetic circuit design, and biocontainment has enabled fine-tuning of immune responses, metabolic pathways, and tissue-specific signaling in a wide range of diseases from cancer to autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, to metabolic and endocrine disorders, neuro-immunological conditions (e.g., amyotrophic lateral sclerosis), infectious diseases including infectious threats without existing approved vaccines (Zika virus) as well as rare genetic disorders. Advances in formulation science, including encapsulation technologies, biomaterial-microbe hybrids, and stimuli-responsive release platforms, have enabled overcoming key translation challenges concerning microbial viability, biodistribution, safety, and controlled activation in complex physiological milieus like the gut (for enteric pathogens), tumor microenvironment (for oncolytic organisms), or injured tissues (for tissue-targeting organisms). Increasing numbers of clinical-stage LBP studies are now conducted under good manufacturing practice, standardized QC, and clinical conditions, ranging from emerging PK, biodistribution, and biomarker-driven studies to those adapted to living entities. The addition of host microbiome profiling, multi-omics analysis, and computational modeling is anticipated to increase therapeutic predictability and patient stratification. Taken together, these advances position live microbial therapeutics as programmable biological medicines with the potential for adaptive, context-specific administration and warrant further clinical development and increased integration within precision medicine-informed therapeutic approaches.
items.titleZh: 活体药物载体：微生物与生物工程平台重新定义精准治疗与免疫调节递送
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述系统梳理了工程化微生物（如基因改造细菌和益生菌）作为活体药物载体的最新进展。这类平台能感知微环境、原位合成治疗分子并调节免疫，在ALS等神经免疫疾病中显示出应用潜力。文章还讨论了制剂封装、生物遏制等关键技术如何推动其走向临床。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS明确列为活体微生物治疗药物的潜在应用方向之一，提示ALS研究者关注这一新兴递送平台，可能为靶向神经炎症或提供神经营养因子开辟新途径。

aiRead.keyFinding: 工程化微生物活体药物载体整合了可编程传感、原位合成和免疫调节功能，在包括ALS在内的多种疾病中具有应用前景，制剂和生物遏制技术的进步正在推动其临床转化。
aiRead.limitation: 综述内容，非原始实验数据；活体微生物疗法在ALS中的具体应用仍处于早期概念阶段，缺乏临床验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该领域针对ALS的临床前或早期临床试验，特别是利用工程菌调节肠道-中枢神经系统轴或递送神经营养因子的研究。

items.abstractZh: 微生物活体治疗药物是一类新型药物递送材料，结合了合成生物学、免疫调节和先进制剂技术，可在空间和时间上实现可控的治疗效果。在活体药物递送系统的广泛领域中，治疗平台包括工程化微生物、哺乳动物免疫细胞、干细胞、病毒载体、产生细胞外囊泡的细胞以及混合生物工程活体材料。本综述聚焦于工程化微生物活体药物载体，包括基因修饰细菌和益生菌平台，因为这些系统独特地将可编程生物传感、原位治疗合成、适应性免疫调节和可控药物递送整合于单一活体底盘之中。设计的微生物和菌群还具有其他独特功能，如微环境感知、基因表达的程序化控制，以及小分子或生物药物无法实现的治疗载荷的持久原位制造。微生物底盘工程、基因回路设计和生物遏制方面的最新进展，已能够微调免疫反应、代谢途径和组织特异性信号，应用于从癌症到自身免疫性和炎症性疾病、代谢和内分泌疾病、神经免疫性疾病（如肌萎缩侧索硬化症）、传染病（包括尚无获批疫苗的传染病威胁，如寨卡病毒）以及罕见遗传病等多种疾病。制剂科学的进展，包括封装技术、生物材料-微生物杂合体和刺激响应释放平台，已能够克服关于微生物活力、生物分布、安全性以及在复杂生理环境（如肠道（针对肠道病原体）、肿瘤微环境（针对溶瘤生物）或受损组织（针对组织靶向生物））中受控激活的关键转化挑战。越来越多的临床阶段活体生物治疗产品研究正在良好生产规范、标准化质量控制和临床条件下进行，范围涵盖新兴的药代动力学、生物分布和生物标志物驱动的研究，以及适应活体实体的研究。宿主微生物组分析、多组学分析和计算建模的加入预计将提高治疗可预测性和患者分层。综上所述，这些进展将活体微生物治疗药物定位为可编程的生物药物，具有适应性、情境特异性给药的潜力，并值得进一步的临床开发和更深入地整合到精准医学指导的治疗方法中。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，系统整合了合成生物学与活体递送平台的最新进展，并明确提及ALS作为潜在适应症，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: End-of-Life Care in an Acute Neurological Ward: A Retrospective Analysis of Clinical Practices During the Last Week of Life.
items.summary: The care of patients with neurological diseases near the end of life (EOL) is challenging and often complicated by prognostic uncertainty. Difficulty recognizing the terminal phase may delay transitions to EOL care, leading to continued use of diagnostic procedures and medical interventions with a limited focus on comfort. This retrospective observational study included medical records of 209 deceased patients with neurological diseases who died in an acute hospital ward. Diagnostic procedures and medical and supportive interventions delivered during the final 7 days of life were extracted. Patients were categorized into 2 groups: acute neurological diseases (ischemic stroke and hemorrhagic stroke) and progressive neurological diseases (Parkinson disease or extrapyramidal and movement disorders, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis). Frequencies of interventions were compared between diagnostic groups and according to documented EOL decision status. In both groups, documented EOL decisions were associated with reduced use of diagnostic procedures and increased use of support measures. Medication administration and supportive care patterns differed between the acute and progressive disease groups and were related to documented EOL decisions. The most frequently administered interventions were oral suctioning (97%), intravenous fluids (70%), antibiotics (45%), pain relief medications (98%), and benzodiazepines (93%). Patients with progressive neurological diseases received more respiratory support interventions than those with acute neurological diseases. Our findings suggest that documenting EOL decisions was related to comfort-focused care, although the frequency varied by disease group. Neurological disease-specific EOL guidelines should be implemented to identify the terminal phase in alignment with the goals of comfort-focused care in a timely manner.
items.titleZh: 急性神经科病房的临终关怀：生命最后一周临床实践的回顾性分析
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了209名在急性神经科病房去世患者的最后一周医疗记录，发现记录临终决策与减少诊断性检查、增加舒适护理措施相关。ALS等进行性神经疾病患者比急性卒中患者接受了更多呼吸支持。研究强调需要针对神经疾病的临终关怀指南，以更早识别临终阶段。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS等神经退行性疾病的临终关怀实践提供了真实世界数据，揭示了进行性神经疾病与急性疾病在生命末期干预模式上的差异，提示ALS患者临终阶段可能面临更多呼吸支持干预，对临床决策和护理标准制定具有参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 记录临终决策与减少诊断程序、增加舒适护理措施相关；进行性神经疾病（含ALS）患者接受更多呼吸支持干预。
aiRead.limitation: 单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，未区分ALS亚型，且未评估护理质量或患者/家属满意度。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对ALS特异性临终关怀指南的制定与验证研究，以及前瞻性研究评估临终决策对患者生活质量的影响。

items.abstractZh: 神经疾病患者的临终关怀充满挑战，常因预后不确定性而复杂化。识别临终阶段的困难可能延迟向临终关怀的过渡，导致继续使用诊断程序和医疗干预，而对舒适度的关注有限。这项回顾性观察性研究纳入了209例在急性医院病房去世的神经疾病患者的医疗记录。提取了生命最后7天内进行的诊断程序和医疗及支持性干预措施。患者被分为两组：急性神经疾病（缺血性卒中和出血性卒中）和进行性神经疾病（帕金森病或锥体外系及运动障碍，以及肌萎缩侧索硬化症）。比较了不同诊断组之间以及根据记录的临终决策状态的干预频率。在两组中，记录的临终决策与诊断程序使用减少和支持措施使用增加相关。药物管理和支持性护理模式在急性和进行性疾病组之间有所不同，并与记录的临终决策相关。最常实施的干预措施包括口腔吸引（97%）、静脉输液（70%）、抗生素（45%）、止痛药物（98%）和苯二氮卓类药物（93%）。进行性神经疾病患者比急性神经疾病患者接受了更多的呼吸支持干预。我们的研究结果表明，记录临终决策与以舒适为中心的护理相关，尽管频率因疾病组而异。应实施针对神经疾病的临终关怀指南，以适时识别临终阶段，与以舒适为中心的护理目标保持一致。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的近期数据，直接聚焦ALS等神经退行性疾病的临终关怀实践，具有明确的ALS临床相关性。

items.title: TDP-43-Associated Neurodegenerative Disease Conceptualization and Integrated Staging: A Review.
items.summary: Classifying disease based on underlying pathobiology rather than clinical phenotype has implications for the development of biomarkers and therapy development. Transactive response DNA-binding protein 43 kDa (TDP-43) pathology is observed across a range of clinically defined neurodegenerative disorders including limbic predominant age-related encephalopathy (LATE), most cases of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), inclusion body myositis, multisystem proteinopathy, and approximately half the cases of frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Despite this shared biology, the current nosology for these neurodegenerative disorders is based on their distinct clinical phenotypes. An alternative approach recognizes the central role of TDP-43 pathology in disease pathogenesis, reserving the use of clinical terms like ALS, FTD, or LATE to describe phenotypic manifestations of underlying pathobiology. This approach also recognizes the converging biomarker and neuropathological data indicating that pathology begins presymptomatically, before the overt clinical manifestations of disease appear. In proposing a pathobiological definition of disease, the goal is to provide a road map for developing biomarkers that accurately reflect the underlying pathobiology of disease and for advancing therapeutic candidates that effectively target fundamental disease mechanisms.
items.titleZh: TDP-43相关神经退行性疾病的概念化与整合分期：综述
